answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The marble counter is kept in shale and falcon reveals each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1935 identities would post 2204 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
